description: Solo participant from Trujillo, Peru, looking for 2–3 teammates. I’m an industrial engineering student with a background in physics (optics and spectroscopy lab work), operations research, Monte Carlo simulation and Python/MATLAB. We will build an interactive mission design game with real orbital dynamics (three-body problem and trajectory sensitivity). We are looking for: a web/front-end developer, a game or UX designer, and someone with video and storytelling skills.
